nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty and Friends Dewy Peachy Shaking Toner

avis.texte: This is my staple, I was planning on just trying out a toner but this is irreplaceable in my routine.

Overall, the Hello Kitty Peach Toner is definitely a great toner. I really enjoy using it in my skincare routine, applying it twice daily, once in the morning and once at night. The toner itself is clear and goes on smooth, and it doesn't bother my skin or feel weird. Something else I enjoy about this toner is the scent. It smells fresh and clean, but it isn't too much. Some skincare is overly scented and too strong for me, and putting it on my face feels incorrect, however, this toner is just right when it comes to the smell. It feels fresh and energizing upon applying it, and it really rejuvenates my skin and keeps it cleared up! One issue I have with this toner is that it doesn't come out of the bottle super easily, and I am not sure if that is just an issue with my bottle or a packaging error, but I really have to shake to get it out and it can be frustrating. However, once I do get it out, it goes on great and feels wonderful. The packaging is also very cute and simple but clean and modern at the same time. I love just seeing it in my cabinet! Overall, the peach toner is something I will purchase again in the future. It helps my skin feel soft and cleared and is by far one of my favorite toners that I have used. I just would love for the product to come out a bit easier!
This is just too scented for someone with normal skin, let alone someone with sensitive skin. I am not a fan of this at all. i didnt see much of any difference using this product

I absolutely love the Hello Kitty and Friends Dewy Peach Shaking Toner! The packaging alone is adorable and makes skincare feel extra fun, but the formula is what really impressed me. After shaking it up, it leaves my skin feeling instantly refreshed, hydrated, and soft without any sticky residue. The peach scent is light and pleasant—not overpowering—and it gives my skin a healthy, dewy glow that lasts throughout the day. It absorbs quickly and layers beautifully with my other skincare products, making it perfect for both morning and night routines. If you're looking for a gentle, hydrating toner that feels luxurious while still being cute and playful, this one is definitely worth trying. It's a great blend of effective skincare and kawaii charm!
From my personal I wasn't a big fan of the peach smell and if you have sensitive skin I would highly recommend to not get this product. Other than that the product served its purpose

avis.titre: A must have for your skin routine!!
avis.texte: Thanks to Hello Kitty® and Friends for sending me this Dewy Peach Shaking Toner for free through BzzAgent! It's lightweight, refreshing, and leaves my skin dewy and soft. I love the subtle peach scent, such a nice touch! Definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a gentle, hydrating toner.

Was weary about efficacy since it is a collab but it is AWESOME and it's hello kitty so I've enjoyed it even more. My skin has felt smoother, I have sensitive skin abd haven't broken out more than I typically would.
This toner is just average, nothing special. While it hydrates, it can feel a bit sticky. The scent is nice but if you are sensitive to scents I would not recommend this.
I absolutely love this toner. It's so adorable and looks so cute in my bathroom. It hasn't broken me out and has greatly minimized my flakey winter skin.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 I've been using the Hello Kitty® and Friends Dewy Peach Shaking Toner and I'm honestly obsessed! The scent is a soft, sweet peach—not overpowering, just fresh and comforting. After shaking it up, the formula feels super lightweight and instantly refreshing on my skin. It gives me that dewy, healthy glow without feeling sticky. The packaging is adorable (hello, Hello Kitty lovers 🩷), and it actually makes my skincare routine feel more fun. After a week of using it, my skin looks more plump, hydrated, and smooth. If you love gentle toners with a yummy scent and cute packaging, this one's definitely worth trying! 🍑✨

avis.titre: Very nice, leaves face shining with no break outs
avis.texte: I use this usually after I shower and about to go out. Before, I was just applying regular lotion to my face l, but now apply this toner then apply lotion. This has made a big difference. The only thing is that I had a hard time opening the bottle. Also you must remember to shake it before every use, otherwise it will not feel good. I also have sensitive skin and this product has luckily not broken me out. Also doesn't really smell like much!

I have combo skin, and I haven't had any issues! It's more of a viscous toner. So it's great as makeup prep and my dry spots. I'm not a huge fan of scented products but the scent doesn't hurt my nose or irritate my face.

I received this product to test out for free in exchange for writing a review on it. I have been easily integrated this toner into my skincare routine, I use it night and day right after I finish washing my face. One thing I need to mention is that you have to shake it really well before using it, otherwise your skin will just feel so oily. Other than that it's honestly been such a savior for me, I have really really dry skin and because it's gotten so cold out, my skin is feeling way more dry than normal, and adding this toner to my routine has helped my skin feel and look more hydrated. They were not kidding when they mentioned it's a dewy toner, it gives your skin this healthy glow from within type of look that I am always aiming for. The packaging is also so so adorable, I love that it's both super cute looking and super effective for my skin.
I have been using this toner for a few weeks now and I love it so far! I use it after I clean my face and before I put on moisturizer. It is very hydrating and feels luxurious on my skin.
I typically use 100% witch hazel as my toner, but this has been a fun change! This Hello Kitty toner is refreshing, hydrating, and moisturizing! I would absolutely use it again!
ive included this product on my daily morning routine and couldn't be more excited that i did that, best toner ever!

This toner is nice. It feels refreshing on my skin and has a nice texture. After applying it, I used a serum and moisturizer, but I didn't notice a difference in how fast they absorbed after the toner.
I love this toner! It's so cute, as a hello kitty fan I love the packaging and the pink bottle. The product smells really good and I feel like it's moisturizing on my skin.

I was so excited to be able to try this toner because it is sooo cutesy and I'm a huge Hello Kitty fan! I typically have super dry skin and this product has been an absolute game changer for me. You do have to shake it extremely well to get it to properly mix though! It has a soft scent and texture, it's easy to apply and leaves a glowing, smooth finish. Just be mindful of how much of the product you are applying, because it can very easily leave your face a little TOO oily and takes a little while to fully absorb. I'd highly recommend this product to anyone who, like me, could use the extra help with hydration and oils!
I absolutely love the Hello Kitty& Friends Dewy Peach Shaking Toner! My face feels so clean after I use it & love how my skin feels. My face felt so soft afterwards & even better before moisturizer!

avis.titre: A must have for dry skin
avis.texte: As the weather gets colder my skin starts to get dry and flaky and this has done an excellent job at keeping my skin hydrated all day and night. I love easily it absorbs in the skin without leaving my skin irritated at all.

I love that it has so many good ingredients in it like Panthenol (for barrier repair) and Hyaluronic Acid ( for hydration). Great step before moisturizer and love that it doesn't have any ingredients that clash with others. So, whatever day I'm on if I'm exfoliating or using retinal, I can use this toner to hydrate and protect my skin.

As a big hello kitty fan, the packaging is super cute and looks great on my shelf! It also smells nice and not super chemically which is a big plus. As for the product itself, I've only been using it a few days but so far it works as intended and has given my skin a nice glow so I will definitely continue to use it!
This toner is very lightweight! Just apply a little to hands And pat onto face. Skin looks amazingly hydrated and glowing. It has hylaronic acid and also has a really nice light scent, which I like.
The toner is refreshing and leaves my skin soft and glowy. The peach scent is super light and sweet, and the Hello Kitty packaging is probably my favorite! It makes my routine feel extra cute☺️💗

avis.titre: This is such a lovely toner!
avis.texte: Amazing! I would absolutely buy this again. The scent is so refreshing, and it makes my skin look and feel amazing. I have pretty dry skin and some toners dry me out, but I could literally feel this one bringing moisture to the problem areas (my T-zone and around my lips can be pretty troublesome around this time of year.) This may be my new go-to winter toner! You get so much in a bottle, I think this is going to last me a good while :)

I love Korean skincare and this makes it even cuter since it's hello kitty. I love the benefits it has for my skin and I always apply before my makeup and I feel my skin a lot smoother. The packaging is also a cute plus since it looks cute on my vanity and not an eye sore.

It's a light texture and doesn't have a strong overpowering scent, I just wish it wasn't so greasy as opposed to dewy. My hair would get stuck to it alot. I didn't notice any difference in skin texture, color, or quality overall but at least it didn't break me out. It's ok if you don't mind an oily finish but I don't think I'd recommend it.

So, first I was interested in using the product because of the cute packaging, and I love trying new face care in general, but I was pleasantly surprised when I loved it! So a lot of toners can be harsh and give a sting to the skin, but this one honestly feels super gentle while still doing the job. My face felt very moisturized after using, and I even forgot to put moisturizer on once after use, LOL, and unlike some other brands, my skin still felt nice snd comfortable. It also gave a nice glowy look to my skin. Overall, one of the best toners I've used.
Love this! You have to really shake it to get the product to mix. I like that it's not too oily nor too watery. It has a very faint soft smell, not chemical or perfume like not sure what it is.

I wasn't sure what to expect from a shaking toner, but this one completely won me over! The Hello Kitty® and Friends Dewy Peach Shaking Toner is not only adorable on my vanity, but surprisingly effective. The first thing you notice is the light, peachy scent—it's fresh, fruity, and not overpowering. After shaking the bottle, the formula blends into a silky, milky toner that feels instantly cooling on the skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face soft, hydrated, and lightly dewy without feeling sticky. I also love how gentle it is. My skin can be finicky, but this toner calms redness and works well under both moisturizer and makeup. The packaging is a bonus—cute, fun, and so on-brand for Hello Kitty fans. If you want something that's hydrating, soothing, and smells amazing, this is a must-try. It's become my go-to step after cleansing, and honestly… it just makes my routine a little happier.

avis.titre: Works well in my skin care routine
avis.texte: This adorable Hello Kitty toner makes me so happy to use every day. It has a lovely light scent that makes it even more fun to use and makes me feel like I'm at the spa. The toner itself felt hydrating and did a good job moisturizing my skin. I usually use it at night but when I have extra time I use it twice a day and my skin looks glowy and healthy.
Loved the scent and easy application to the skin. It made my skin feel extremely hydrating and left a nice glow.

avis.titre: This toner has worked wonders for my skin barrier!
avis.texte: I usually don't leave reviews that often, so this is how I know that this product has worked very well for me. I started using this product around a week ago and have noticed immediate changes to my skin's texture and overall appearance! I've noticed that my skin has a more natural glow compared to its usual dull appearance. My face also feels more smooth overall. I also enjoy the moisturizing properties of this toner since the dry, cold weather is my skin's worst enemy!! Overall, I really enjoyed this product, and will definitely be repurchasing!

The Hello Kitty Crème Dewy Peach Shaking Toner has a pleasant peach scent and feels refreshing on the skin. I've noticed my complexion looking a bit more even, and it provides a good amount of hydration without feeling heavy. Overall, it leaves my face soft, dewy, and super refreshed. 🍑✨

I was giving this product for free for my honest opinion. There's a visible difference from your dry face and when you use this, your face definitely shines more. Feels a little greasy after applying it to your face. The toner does have a bubble soap smell to it. The pink packaging is cute though and the toner liquid looks shiny when you pour it out. For me it doesn't give that moisture refreshing feeling but it does feel like oil to the touch. Absorbs fine after a bit.

Loved the scent and easy application to the skin. It made my skin feel extremely hydrating and left a nice glow. Only downside was my skin had a small reaction to the scent or else it would have been a full 5/5 review!
